gloss: way of proceeding; approach; method of advancing

definitions.gloss: way of proceeding; approach; how to proceed
definitions.explanation: the method or manner in which something is carried out or advanced

examples.japanese: プロジェクトの{進|すす}め{方|かた}を{相談|そうだん}する。
examples.english: To discuss how to proceed with the project.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{進|すす}め{方|かた}について{意見|いけん}がある。
examples.english: I have an opinion about how to run the meeting.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}の{進|すす}め{方|かた}は{人|ひと}それぞれだ。
examples.english: Everyone has their own approach to work.

notes:
{進|すす}め{方|かた} means "way of proceeding" or "approach to doing something."

PATTERN:
Formed with {〜方|かた} (way of doing), a productive suffix attached to verb stems ({進|すす}める → {進|すす}め{方|かた}).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- プロジェクトの{進|すす}め{方|かた}: how to proceed with a project
- {会議|かいぎ}の{進|すす}め{方|かた}: how to run a meeting
- {仕事|しごと}の{進|すす}め{方|かた}: approach to work
- {進|すす}め{方|かた}を{相談|そうだん}する: to discuss how to proceed

RELATED {〜方|かた} WORDS:
- {話|はな}し{方|かた}: way of speaking
- {考|かんが}え{方|かた}: way of thinking
- やり{方|かた}: way of doing
- {書|か}き{方|かた}: way of writing
